name: darkrpg-renderer
description: Browser-based three.js renderer for the DarkRPG Minecraft 1.20.1 world (Node does decode/asset bake; WebGL2 does the rendering). See PLAN.md.

scripts.bake: npm run census && npm run pack:assets && npm run bake:shells && npm run bake:lod
scripts.test:fast: node --test tests/view-policy.test.mjs tests/web-shell.test.mjs tests/web-store.test.mjs tests/web-mesh.test.mjs tests/shell-pack.test.mjs tests/web-index.test.mjs tests/web-shellevict.test.mjs
